lines: Financial data is derived from official PBAM quarterly press releases (T1 evidence). FY2021–FY2023 figures are approximate, based on trajectory analysis. FY2024 and FY2025 are precise from official Q4 earnings releases. CAGR (FY2021-FY2025): Total Assets ~14% | Net Income ~19% — both classified as ACCELERATING. [E-0001, E-0003, E-0004]

Key performance highlights (FY2025): Net Income +13.5% YoY | ROA 1.61% (#1 in asset class <$5B) | NIM 4.76% | Efficiency ratio 48.46% | NPS 81 World Class (×15 consecutive quarters) | EPS $6.92 | TBV/share $45.75 | Core deposits CAGR exceptional [E-0003, E-0004]

⚠️  CREDIT QUALITY FLAG: NPA/total assets deteriorated from 0.47% (Q4'24) to 2.00% (Q4'25). Nine classified loans as of Dec 31, 2024; new CCO (August 2025) + new COO (April 2026) both have credit/risk oversight mandates. This creates urgency for systematic credit portfolio analytics — a direct Data Cloud + nCino portfolio analytics opportunity. [E-0005]

CalPrivate Bank's financial trajectory is classified as ACCELERATING on core growth metrics (net income CAGR ~19%, assets CAGR ~14% over 5 years) with STABLE-HIGH profitability (ROA consistently in top decile nationally) and VARIABLE credit quality (significant Q4'25 deterioration from NPA 0.47% to 2.00%). The efficiency ratio improvement from ~52% to 48.46% reflects disciplined expense management and operating leverage. [E-0003, E-0004]
